# Repository identity

- `icon.svg`: scalable document-and-citation mark, navy and cobalt on ivory.
- `social-preview.jpg`: repository banner and GitHub social preview, 2:1, below 1 MB. The source artwork was generated for this project.

The French and English READMEs display the banner directly from this directory.

To use the same banner when someone shares the repository URL: open repository **Settings → General → Social preview → Edit → Upload an image**, then select `social-preview.jpg`. This administrative setting is separate from the README and cannot be activated by committing an image.

GitHub does not offer an individual repository avatar. Its owner avatar is an account setting; this branding does not change it.
